title: Understanding and Mitigating the Bias Inheritance in LLM-based Data Augmentation on Downstream Tasks
findings: The paper found a misalignment between LLM-generated responses and real human responses to value-related questions, which include religious topics. This misalignment was more pronounced for Eastern cultures (e.g., Arabic, Chinese) than for Western cultures (e.g., Portuguese, Spanish), indicating the model's limited understanding of diverse human value systems.
